::: {#def-no-interference .theorem}
## No interference assumption

No variable in a given [observational unit](#def-observational-unit) is a [parent](#def-parent) of a non-[equivalent](#def-equivalence) variable in another unit.

$$
X\notin \mathbf{Pa}(Y)\quad \forall\, X\in \mathscr O_i,\ Y\in \mathscr O_j,\ X\not\sim Y,\ i\ne j.
$$

This assumption and [no within-covariate influence](#def-no-spillover) together are the no-interference content of the stable unit treatment value assumption (SUTVA).
:::
